reported_problem: The initial MutationExecutor.Exec(query,args) API could express COMMIT or implicit-commit DDL before a callback error; rollback could not undo already committed timing facts.
fix_scope: The executor API now exposes only fixed once-only Apply; no arbitrary query, transaction commit or DDL method. This does not sandbox arbitrary Go caller code or captured outer transaction references.
remaining_requirements: Actual native success/failure/panic/ignored-error/duplicate Apply tests and real SQL rollback evidence
Original D admission/verifier/prerequisite checks before the automatic terminal CAS; fixed Apply is not independent authority
Actual caller integration into the original bounded transaction and lock order
Reader/provider facts, new migration and GC/reference composition
Exact final input/source checks and owned artifact cleanup
